messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: For R Mentors:  Please start scoring!
parts:
This is an important message to all of the R GSoC mentors on this list.
(some information for students at the bottom of this email)

*Please* start scoring applications ASAP.

Google has tightened the timeline for organizations to request slots
this year, and we (the R GSoC admins) need to request slots no later
than Tuesday, April 10th. Because of this, we really need mentors to do
two things as soon as possible.

The first, as in previous years, is that we ask all R mentors to score
every student application that you feel competent to weigh in on. R
received 65 applications this year, most of them earnest attempts by
real students, so I'm afraid that is a lot of work.

The second thing we need all mentors to do is to select 'Wish to Mentor'
for all of the credible applications for 'your' project(s). The number
of 'Wish to Mentor' selections also figures into Google's math on how
slots are assigned.

We encourage mentors to leave either public comments (which the student
can see) seeking clarification or additional information, or private
comments (which only the other R mentors can see) discussing your
reasoning. Comments default to Private.

For students, if you receive public comments on your application, please
respond as quickly as possible to help us in our analysis process.

Regards,

- Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/

IM: bgpbraverock

messages.subject: For R Mentors:  Preliminary work done on Interactive teaching toolkit for Financial Derivatives
parts:
Dear Mentors

Title: Interactive Teaching tool for Financial Derivatives
Link id: santosh_sssihl

Further to my proposal (title mentioned above), i have done some preliminary work on the project. 

I have implemented 3 functions as of now- 


1) A Present value calculation 
2) A Bond price calculation 
3) Bond price- maturity relationship depicted in an interactive plot with sliders to choose coupon rate and discount rate.


Please see screenshots and attached code.

Note: 
1) The above implementation is for demo alone- for proof of concept. i will replace my own functions with functions in R packages in the course of the project. 
2) The same was tested only on R 2.12.0. Packages required are mentioned on top of the attached r file (basically rpanel, tcltk, tcltk2, tkrplot etc). 

Awaiting your feedback 


Santosh Sridhar

Best wishes,

Virgilio

Since I know some of the mentors on this list are just getting back from
a four day weekend, I'm going to bump this to the tops of your lists.

Scoring is proceeding, but we need all mentors to log into melange and
score all the proposals you are qualified to weight in on as soon as
possible.

Additionally, for mentors who have not yet selected 'Wish to Mentor' on
credible proposals for 'your' projects, please do so as soon as
possible, preferably early today.

The deadline for R to do initial slot requests is today, Tuesday.

Full details below, thank you for your assistance. Please do not
hesitate to contact me off-list with questions.

- Brian
